source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 08 New VW Transmission Adapters for 2.5L engines.pdf
title: Volkswagen Transmission Adapter for Automatic-Transmission Service
lead: MOC has developed a new adapter for use on various Volkswagen® vehicles equipped with the 09G transmission (Part No. 94784). When performing a transmission service, temporarily remove and replace the oil cooler on top of the transmission with this adapter easy service.
body: See below for pictures inside a Volkswagen® engine compartment showing the location of the Oil Cooler where this new adapter is connected.
